title: Chemically Competent V. natriegens Cells
author: Carlos H
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.pumdnu6
materials: Pool the cells in two 50ml falcons
Pool the cells into one 50ml falcon
Aliquot the cells into chilled tubes (50µl aliquots)

steps.title: Inoculate growth medium
steps.instruction: Inoculate 150 ml BHI supplemented with V2‑Salts into a baffled flask.

steps.title: Incubate culture to OD 0.4
steps.instruction: Incubate the flask with shaking at 30 °C, 200 rpm until the optical density reaches 0.4 (approximately 2 h 30 min).

steps.title: First centrifugation and supernatant removal
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the culture at 3000 g for 5 min at room temperature, then discard the supernatant completely.

steps.title: Resuspend in MgCl₂ solution
steps.instruction: Resuspend the cell pellet by gentle inversion in 5 ml of 100 mM MgCl₂, then bring the volume up to 30 ml with additional 100 mM MgCl₂.

steps.title: Second centrifugation and supernatant removal
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 3000 g for 4 min at room temperature, then discard the supernatant completely.

steps.title: Resuspend in CaCl₂ solution
steps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet by gentle inversion in 5 ml of 100 mM CaCl₂, then bring the volume up to 30 ml with additional 100 mM CaCl₂.

steps.title: Incubate with CaCl₂
steps.instruction: Incubate the suspension at room temperature for 20 min.

steps.title: Third centrifugation and supernatant removal
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 3000 g for 4 min at room temperature, then discard the supernatant completely.

steps.title: Resuspend in modified Inoue buffer
steps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet by gentle inversion in 1.5 ml of modified Inoue buffer.

steps.title: Add DMSO to final concentration
steps.instruction: Add DMSO to achieve a final concentration of 7 % (v/v), i.e., add 105 µl DMSO to the suspension.
